response.sql:
WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    COUNT(*) as race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
),
total_races AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM races
),
circuit_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.circuitId,
    cc.race_count,
    CAST(cc.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total AS share,
    AVG(CAST(cc.race_count AS FLOAT) / tr.total) OVER () AS avg_share
  FROM circuit_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN total_races tr
),
filtered_circuits AS (
  SELECT 
    circuitId,
    race_count,
    share,
    share - avg_share AS excess
  FROM circuit_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  circuitId,
  race_count,
  share,
  excess
FROM filtered_circuits
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in the races table represents one race; race count per circuit is the number of rows grouped by circuitId
Average share is the mean of individual circuit shares: avg_share = 1 / (number of distinct circuits)
